# Purpose
This code is a database migration script using Alembic, a database migration tool for SQLAlchemy. The script alters the `content_kind` column in the `derived_contents` table, changing its type from `VARCHAR` to `Text` and making it non-nullable. The [`upgrade`](<#upgrade>) function applies these changes, while the [`downgrade`](<#downgrade>) function reverses them, dropping the index and reverting the column type back to `VARCHAR`.
